Value : Value means the worth of one unit of
a commodity in terms of units of another

commodity in exchange. Value has two different
meanings.

( 4) Exchange value varies with time and
place.

( 1) Use Value (Utility Value): The use value

is determined by the usefulness of a
commodity to a consumer. for his/ her
various needs. For example, food, water,
sunlight, etc. have a high use value for
all people in general.

Price: Price means the exchange value (worth)
of a commodity measured in terms of units
of currency.
